2.00.betting_forecast: 5/2 Moon Over The Sea, 3/1 Bohemian Breeze, 5/1 Marinakis, Qaaeadd, 9/1 Knightmare, 10/1 Endofastorm, 14/1 Itsgottobefun,
2.00.spotlight_verdict: The return to Bath puts ENDOFASTORM (narrowly preferred) and Moon Over The Sea front of the shortlist, ahead of Bohemian Breeze.[Steve Boow]

horses.spotlight_comment: Showed clear signs of a return to form with fourth-place finish in latest AW start and he is just as effective on turf; possibilities off 1lb below last winning mark.
Dual winner at Bath, including off 1lb higher in most recent turf attempt; not in the same form on AW since but may prove resurgent returned to this course; one to consider.
horses.breeding: b m Galileo Gold - Red Fuschia

horses.spotlight_comment: Belied his big odds with a placed effort on penultimate outing (AW) but otherwise has weak claims on form.
Still a maiden and has inconsistent form for current yard; campaigned mostly on AW and has posted two duck eggs on turf; enough to prove upped further in trip.
Gained all three wins for Ian Williams at classified level on AW; remains to be seen whether he can hold his form back on turf; wears new headgear on stable debut.
Only 1-14 on turf but gained the win at Bath and returns here in form, having been placed in last two AW attempts (seven-time winner in that sphere); shortlisted.
horses.breeding: b g Sea The Moon - Veiled Beauty

horses.spotlight_comment: Seven-race maiden, campaigned mostly on AW; not particularly solid on form; returns to turf for first time since debut.
Inconsistent maiden but posted one of his better efforts last time (9.5f, AW; second start for new yard) while shaping as if this new trip is worth exploring.

2.30.betting_forecast: 2/1 Party Island, 3/1 Thapa Vc, 7/2 Rating, 11/2 Moby Quick, 8/1 Raintown, 12/1 Bobby Dassler, 25/1 Paps Of Jura.
2.30.spotlight_verdict: Kept to Bath, solid RATING may build on her reappearance effort and register a first success on turf. In-form 9yo Party Island is second pick, ahead of Thapa Vc who has a good record here.[Steve Boow]

horses.spotlight_comment: Has a modest strike-rate but his Bath record is largely sound and includes a win last October; soundly beaten here on stable/seasonal debut, albeit perhaps needed the run.
Not particularly solid on his AW form (at up to 9.5f) for current stable; gained sole win on turf (6f; off 3lb higher) but has something to prove over this new trip.
Seven-race maiden who last two efforts (8.5f/1m4f, AW) suggest this return to 1m2f, combined with first-time hood, may prove ideal; improvement is not out of the question.
horses.breeding: b g Mountain High - Haidees Reflection

horses.spotlight_comment: Has a better strike-rate on AW than on turf but he's in form, creditable third at Lingfield on Good Friday last time; gained last win off 5lb higher (in July 2024); shortlisted.
Has a better strike-rate on AW than on turf and returns to this sphere with a doubt over his current form; however, may prove resurgent off current mark dropped in class.
AW winner for current yard (maiden previously); ran respectably (1m, good to soft) on seasonal debut, taking Bath record to 333; has form over 1m2f; looks a solid contender.
13-time winner who has frame possibilities returned to Bath with AW reappearance under his belt; record here comprises a 2l fourth in this race last year and two wins over 1m.
horses.breeding: b g The Gurkha - Merritt Island

3.00.betting_forecast: 2/1 Leucothea, 9/2 Crown Of Ivy, 5/1 Sovereign Glory, 11/2 Global Success, King Of Montenegro, 10/1 Dandyman Dan,
3.00.spotlight_verdict: Global Success may build on a course effort that sets the standard. Judged on breeding and other factors, LEUCOTHEA is a particularly interesting type among the newcomers. Crown Of Ivy is second pick. The market signals should help to complete the picture.[Steve Boow]

horses.spotlight_comment: February foal; 60,000euros foal, 50,000euros yearling; from the first crop of Naval Crown; half-brother to 6f winner King Of Bears (including 2yo; RPR 92); yard has had a good record with 2yos down the years.

April foal; 38,000gns yearling; Dandy Man half-brother to Italian 7f winner Iraklion (including 2yo); dam unraced, out of French 6f 2yo Group 1 scorer; one of two newcomers for his stable; market instructive.
Always behind in the Brocklesby, having been a 40-1 shot; doesn't seem an imminent winner and is perhaps best watched unless the market signals are stronger this time.
Belied her 50-1 odds and showed some promise with fifth of 13 at Bath (5f, good) ten days ago, shaping as if today's extra yardage will suit; sets only an ordinary standard but may show improvement.
April foal; £25,000 yearling; Earthlight half-brother to 6f winner Sacred Falls (RPR 78); dam 6f/7f 2yo scorer (85), half-sister to Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint winner Belvoir Bay; check the betting.

April foal; 52,000gns yearling; Soldier's Call half-sister to 5f 2yo winner Wateen (RPR 83); unraced dam out of 7f/1m 2yo Listed scorer, is granddaughter of 5f 2yo Group 3 winner; likely type on breeding.
February foal; 34,000gns yearling; by Cotai Glory and first foal of 1m-winning (RPR 81) half-sister to 7f Group 2 scorer Sacred; heed the market signals.
March foal; by Havana Grey; sibling to four winners, notably Rosy Affair (5f/6f including Group 3; RPR 107); dam 5f 2yo scorer (82); one of two newcomers for his yard; market informative.

3.30.betting_forecast: 11/4 Alvin, 7/2 Comic Strip, 5/1 Solar Invincible, 8/1 Angel Numbers, Saucy Jane, 9/1 Artista, 10/1 London Is Blue, 14/1
3.30.spotlight_verdict: With further improvement possible in the retained cheekpieces, SOLAR INVINCIBLE is taken to follow up his C&D success. Interesting Artista is second choice, ahead of Alvin who returns to 5f for the first time since his novice win.[Steve Boow]

horses.spotlight_comment: Maiden winner for previous yard; absent and gelded since failing to beat a rival last August on debut for new stable; best watched unless the market speaks positively.
Campaigned on AW this year, best form when scoring readily over 5f in February and close third (despite wide trip) over 6f last time; may do better still; possibilities back on turf.
horses.breeding: b g Kodi Bear - Boston Beauties

horses.spotlight_comment: Insole Rossa Ryan 8-1 76 81 84 Best effort since switched to AW when runner-up on penultimate start; capable of being involved and she gained sole win on turf; however, 0-8 since that debut performance.
Steadily back to form in AW contests this year, creditable fourth latest; possibly on her way to a new peak and looks interesting back on turf; won in this sphere last spring.
Has built up a solid record on AW, latterly 1123 since handicapping and dropped to 5f; good effort on reappearance last time; likely player, assuming he proves as good on turf.
horses.breeding: b g Blue Point - Laugh Aloud

horses.spotlight_comment: Not particularly solid on her AW form this term for new yard but may prove resurgent in this scenario, being a turf winner who is having first handicap attempt in this sphere.
horses.breeding: b f Twilight Son - Royal Seal

horses.spotlight_comment: Campaigned on AW since handicapping, winning twice as a 2yo but showing no further progress this year; chance partly depends on the effects of this return to turf.
Ended last season with a poor effort on AW; progressive (211) in handicaps on turf, the wins over 5.3f at Brighton, and may have more to offer in this sphere; still of interest.
Consistent efforts in AW sprints this year and ties in with Comic Strip on the latest one; registered sole success on turf and looks a solid contender returned to this sphere.
horses.breeding: b f Lope Y Fernandez - Sea Horn

horses.spotlight_comment: Successful over C&D (good; switched back to turf from AW) last time, taking record since wearing cheekpieces to 21341 and form figures in this sphere to 441; upped in class but receives weight all round; respected with further progress plausible.

4.00.betting_forecast: 3/1 The Feminine Urge, The Thames Boatman, 9/2 Moe's Legacy, 5/1 Toolatetonegotiate, 7/1 So Smart, 8/1 Solar Edge, 10/1
4.00.spotlight_verdict: Grace Harris holds a solid hand with THE FEMININE URGE (preferred) and So Smart who tie in with each other on C&D running 22 days ago, while last year's runner-up The Thames Boatman completes the shortlist.[Steve Boow]

horses.spotlight_comment: Ties in with a couple of today's rivals on C&D reappearance form but ideally needs a return to further; yet to score over a bare 5f; gained his Bath win over the extended 5f.
horses.breeding: b g Footstepsinthesand - La Dama Boba

horses.spotlight_comment: Has plenty of Bath form but mostly over the extended 5f, including three wins; below par returned to this venue last time after two sound AW performances at Wolverhampton.
horses.breeding: gr m Havana Grey - Powerful Dream

horses.spotlight_comment: Front-runner who is a five-time winner, including at Bath; respectable fourth over C&D on reappearance and ties in with new stablemate The Feminine Urge on that effort; shortlisted.
horses.breeding: b g Dandy Man - Model Looks

horses.spotlight_comment: Has done his winning off marks in the 60s; mixed record (some good results, some not so good) off marks in the 70s and he lacks recent match practice; not the percentage call.
horses.breeding: gr g Havana Grey - Heavenly Edge

horses.spotlight_comment: Successful three times for previous yard, most recently last June; creditable third over C&D (good) on stable/seasonal debut; may build on that effort; respected off the same mark.
Multiple AW winner; hindered by being hampered on Good Friday last time; 0-15 on turf but ran creditably (finished second) in this race last year; place claims off same mark.
horses.breeding: b g Havana Grey - Gilt Linked

horses.spotlight_comment: Multiple AW winner; hindered by being hampered on Good Friday last time; 0-15 on turf but ran creditably (finished second) in this race last year; place claims off same mark.
horses.breeding: b g Havana Grey - Gilt Linked

horses.spotlight_comment: Three-time winner on AW, most recently in January; 0-9 on turf and not helped by being 8lb higher than last attempt in this sphere; however, her consistency is a positive.

4.30.betting_forecast: 9/4 Candonomore, 100/30 Special Ghaiyyath, 5/1 Aspull, Happy Banner, 9/1 Caledonian, Eupator, 10/1 Nakaaha.
4.30.spotlight_verdict: On recent form CANDONOMORE (nap) looks the strongest option. Aspull (second choice) and Special Ghaiyyath are interesting contenders returned to turf.[Steve Boow]

horses.spotlight_comment: Raced four times in his first season last year, producing a solid novice record (132) on turf prior to a lesser effort in AW handicap; gelded since; remains open to further progress back in this sphere and reappearance may be the time to catch him; respected.

Made a winning handicap debut in AW contest as a 2yo but failed to transfer the form back to turf last year; admittedly still has low mileage and may have a better 2026 campaign; heed the market signals.

Four wins at 1m and 7f for previous yard; 0-5 for current stable but he's threatening to regain the winning thread, beaten a short head at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last week when switched back to turf from AW; major contender off the same mark.
AW form since wearing blinkers features his only two wins; 0-4 on turf and has a bit to prove with the headgear removed back in this sphere.
horses.breeding: ch g Persian King - Aurora Gold

horses.spotlight_comment: AW form features his sole win, as a 2yo, and close second at Chelmsford when last seen; by mo means certain to go one better, with turf record (76537) not totally convincing.
Completed a double last summer (maiden previously); not in the same form since but perhaps needed her Doncaster reappearance; may prove resurgent with that outing under her belt.

Clutterbuck Dylan Hogan 100-30 79 87 89 One win apiece for his two previous yards, taking his turf record to 22411; ran well on AW last time and sold for 25,000gns since; interesting returned to this sphere on debut for another new stable.

5.00.betting_forecast: 5/2 Zoustellar, 7/2 Denby's Dream, 11/2 Arvana Belle, 6/1 Miss Mambo, Takeitorleaveit, 7/1 Beryl's Girl, 10/1 Mali Star.
5.00.spotlight_verdict: This return to turf should not be a problem for seven-race maiden DENBY'S DREAM, who did well to take second behind a big improver on Polytrack a fortnight ago and remains unexposed over this trip. Recent Yarmouth winner Zoustellar ought to go well again and is second choice, ahead of handicap debutante Miss Mambo.[Chris Wilson]

horses.spotlight_comment: Scored on nursery debut at Brighton (6f, good) in August and finished close up there (6f/7f) on next two outings; upped in trip again for this reappearance outing; won't be far away if fully tuned out.
Ended three-race 2yo campaign with quite promising third in C&D (good to soft) maiden in September, albeit in a slowly run race; makes handicap debut after 226-day absence but has potential.

A maiden after seven starts but encountered some traffic before running on well to snatch second (no threat to winner) at Lingfield (1m, AW) a fortnight ago and remains unexposed over this trip; one to consider.

Just a respectable fifth on nursery debut at Southwell (1m, AW) in October and below that form at Chelmsford the following month; gelded during the winter, though, and improvement is possible this year.
horses.breeding: b g Sands Of Mali - Macau

horses.spotlight_comment: Gave pretty good account when third of six in C&D (good to soft) maiden won comfortably by short-odds favourite ten days ago, her fourth start, and could have some improvement to come in handicaps.

Displayed improvement to reward strong market support over C&D (soft; first-time cheekpieces) on nursery debut in September; off since a lesser effort in October, though, and needs to prove himself on today's much faster ground.

Came from off the pace to open account in first-time cheekpieces at Yarmouth (1m, good) this month, her seventh start; effectively 5lb higher here if Jack Callan's reduced claim is considered but might be seen to even better effect on this stiffer track.
